title: Design intake spam classification (classify after capture, never reject)
description: Design for spam handling on Prospectus intake (anth.us engage-contact-v1 and app waitlists): docs/INTAKE_SPAM.md. Rule: a valid message is always accepted and the visitor always gets the same reply; spam is classified and labelled after durable inbox capture, never rejected or deleted. Layer 1 is local deterministic heuristics with named reason codes (gibberish name/company, template-only message, Gmail dot scatter, links/markup, honeypot, timing, repeat key) stored as spam_check on the inquiry; likely-spam prospects get the likely-spam label and no follow-up date, hidden by default with Spam/Not spam corrections. Optional layer 2 is a Jev decision through a Cyclotron standing run, pending privacy (contact-v1), IAM and Cyclotron stack decisions. Rollout: spec, shadow mode, then labelling. Design only; no implementation in this issue.
